# jamjam v{VERSION}

Low-latency P2P audio communication for musicians.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|----------|------|-------|
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `jamjam_{VERSION}_aarch64.dmg` | macOS 11+ required |
| macOS (Intel) | `jamjam_{VERSION}_x64.dmg` | macOS 11+ required |
| Windows | `jamjam_{VERSION}_x64-setup.exe` | Windows 10+ required |
| Linux (AppImage) | `jamjam_{VERSION}_amd64.AppImage` | |
| Linux (deb) | `jamjam_{VERSION}_amd64.deb` | Debian/Ubuntu |

## System Requirements

- **macOS**: 11.0 (Big Sur) or later
- **Windows**: 10 (1903) or later
- **Linux**: glibc 2.31+, PipeWire 1.0 or later (older `pipewire-alsa` makes the audio threads spin at 100% CPU)
